title: Response of GET /api/v1/diagram/:task (JSON form): everything the viewer (5A.3) and the editor (5B) draw
description: Readers: owner, coordinator, a reporter whose scope holds the task; anonymous 401. ETag = sha256 of the response body; If-None-Match answers 304, so the phone and the Zumi tab can poll cheaply. ?rev=N returns that revision's document with pointer, comments and proposals of now (a past revision is immutable: Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable). ?format=md returns text/markdown (the agent export, contract section 5.1) instead of this object. tracks is kept in the JSON form for the build's staleness check; the Markdown form leaves it out.

comments.description: Comment threads anchored on nodes of the returned document: each root is a feedback with a feedback.anchor line in the side store (rev 2, M3: the anchor never comes from state.json); replies are the feedback whose reply_to chain reaches the root. Newest root first; closed threads of the state window included (status tells).

removed_comments.description: Threads whose node_id is not in the returned document (the node was removed later, or the asked rev predates it). Listed, never dropped.

proposals.description: Open proposals only. The read-only viewer shows the count; the editor shows the diff.

text.description: Verbatim. The owner's Vietnamese is never rewritten.
